interactiveReplay.title: Follow one simulated decision.
interactiveReplay.description: Watch an agent compare two office-chair listings, find missing facts, and try the comparison again.
interactiveReplay.question: Which office chair suits a taller adult for less than $400?
interactiveReplay.questionNote: This replay is one invented shopping decision. It does not measure live AI traffic.
interactiveReplay.listingNote: The supplier has the seat-height range and weight capacity. Those facts are missing from your compared listing.
interactiveReplay.missingReading: Your listing does not state this fact.
interactiveReplay.fieldsNote: The agent checks the fields one at a time. A missing fact stays visible as “Not stated”.
interactiveReplay.pickReason: The rival states its seat-height range and weight capacity, so the agent can check those fit requirements.
interactiveReplay.fixNote: Add the existing supplier specifications to the compared listing. No specifications are invented, and this example changes nothing in a store.
interactiveReplay.rerunReason: With both specifications stated, this sample agent chooses your lower-priced chair from the two listings.
interactiveReplay.outcomeNote: This change in the pick is illustrative. A real simulation can reach a different result.
